watches.name: Viqueria Heritage – Private Sale
watches.description: The Viqueria Heritage V1 combines a genuine vintage hand-wound Poljot 2609 movement with a contemporary 40.5 mm stainless-steel case. Each movement is individually serviced, regulated and tested before assembly. Available in Black Pearl, Ocean Blue and White Pearl , with only 3 pieces per colour for this private release. Private Release A small return from the Viqueria archives. Some watches are created to mark a moment. Others remain part of the story long after they disappear from the collection. The Viqueria Heritage V1 belongs to the second category. Originally created around a vintage hand-wound Poljot 2609 movement, the Heritage V1 was our interpretation of a classic mechanical watch from another era. Simple proportions, a domed crystal, polished details and a mechanical movement with a real history behind it. Today, we have the opportunity to make a very small number of Heritage V1 watches available again . This is not a new production run. It is a private release , reserved for members of the Viqueria community who received access to this page. A MECHANICAL PIECE OF THE PAST At the heart of every Heritage V1 is a vintage Poljot 2609 hand-wound movement . These movements were manufactured decades ago, during an era in which mechanical watchmaking was built around simple, robust and serviceable constructions. Before being installed in a Heritage V1, each movement is individually inspected, serviced, regulated and tested. The result is something increasingly unusual today. A contemporary watch built around a genuine vintage mechanical heart . Small variations between movements may naturally exist. We consider them part of the character of the watch rather than something to hide. INSPIRED BY THE SPACE AGE The Heritage project was born from our fascination with the golden age of mechanical exploration. In 1961, Yuri Gagarin became the first human to travel into space aboard Vostok 1. It was an era defined by engineering, courage and an extraordinary belief in what technology could achieve. The Heritage V1 was never intended to reproduce a historical watch. Instead, we wanted to capture something of that period through a contemporary Viqueria design, built around an authentic vintage movement. Past and present, inside the same watch. THREE INTERPRETATIONS For this private release, the Heritage V1 is available in three dial variations. BLACK PEARL Deep, discreet and slightly more formal. The black sunray dial changes character under different lighting, moving from almost matte to highly reflective. OCEAN BLUE The most vibrant interpretation of the Heritage V1. Its blue sunray finish reacts continuously to the light, giving the dial a different appearance throughout the day. WHITE PEARL Clean, bright and timeless. The light dial emphasises the applied markers and gives the Heritage V1 its most classic appearance. ONLY A FEW ARE AVAILABLE This private release is intentionally small. We currently have only: 3 Black Pearl 3 Ocean Blue 3 White Pearl Once these watches are gone, we cannot guarantee that the Heritage V1 will become available again. For this reason, the page is not listed on our public store and can only be accessed through the private link shared with our community. watches.name: Trecento – Ocean Jasper
watches.description: A professional diver inspired by the golden age of cushion-case watches. Built for the depths, the Trecento combines robust 300-meter water resistance, functional engineering, and distinctive Italian design. Bold in form. Reliable in performance. A diver designed to explore beyond the surface. Trecento GMT — Ocean Jasper Three hundred meters down, the color still holds. There is a moment, descending into open water, when the surface disappears and only the depth remains. The Trecento was designed for that moment. And for every moment that follows. This edition is now available in pre-order. Deliveries are expected starting September 2026. A dial shaped by nature The Ocean Jasper dial is not designed. It is discovered. Each piece is cut from natural stone, selected for its structure, then adapted to the geometry of the Trecento. No pattern repeats. Waves, veins, and mineral formations create compositions that feel almost topographic, as if mapping an unknown surface. The result is dense, textured, alive. A dial that feels less like a finish, and more like a fragment of something larger. The GMT hand, marked in contrasting color, brings order to this complexity. A precise line moving across an unpredictable landscape. A tool, finished like an instrument The cushion case sits naturally on the wrist, 43.5mm across, 48.5mm lug to lug, closer to a 42mm in wear. The 316L stainless steel is shaped, then finished. Brushed where function demands grip, polished where light deserves to travel. The contrast is deliberate. Precision outside, raw matter within. Two time zones. One glance. The Seiko NH34 automatic movement drives a true GMT complication. The fourth hand tracks a second time zone independently, without disrupting local time. The 24-hour rehaut reinforces the reading. No calculation. No ambiguity. 300 meters is not a claim. It is a standard. The ceramic bezel resists scratches and UV fade. The helium escape valve handles saturation diving. The domed sapphire with double AR coating remains readable at depth and in direct sunlight. BGW9 and C3 Super-LumiNova charge quickly and hold through the night. The Trecento does not ask to be noticed. But some surfaces are impossible to ignore.

watches.name: Prometeo – Koi Special Edition
watches.description: A limited edition of 100 individually numbered pieces. The Prometeo Koi reveals a deep lacquered black dial where two koi emerge only when darkness falls. Minimal in daylight. Luminous in darkness. A quiet scene beneath the surface. The architecture of the Prometeo, with a presence entirely its own. The Prometeo, reimagined. Something bold, elegant, and unmistakably Italian continues to evolve. The Viqueria Prometeo has long represented the core of our collection. A model designed to balance proportion, presence, and everyday wearability in a compact 39.5 mm case with integrated bracelet. Its architecture remains unchanged — clean, structured, and versatile — built to move effortlessly between formal and casual settings without losing identity. Engineered for daily use and longevity, it retains the reliable Miyota 8215 automatic movement, sapphire crystal, 100 meters of water resistance, and generous BGW9 Super-LumiNova for clarity in low light. A modern mechanical watch, designed with Italian restraint and intention. This special edition begins from that foundation. But it moves somewhere quieter. The Koi Special Edition For this limited and numbered release, the Prometeo becomes a scene rather than a surface. The dial is finished in deep lacquered black, not as a simple color, but as depth. Beneath it, two koi move in a suspended moment. Leaves and details emerge only when light disappears. The composition remains still. Time moves across it. Unlike previous versions of the Prometeo, this edition is not defined by material variation or dial texture. Every piece shares the same dial. The same scene. The same quiet balance between light and darkness. In daylight, the watch appears minimal. Controlled. Almost restrained. In darkness, the composition reveals itself through Super-LumiNova, transforming the dial into a different environment entirely. Not brighter. Just more present. The architecture of the Prometeo remains. The mechanics remain. But the perception shifts. A familiar form, a different presence The integrated bracelet, brushed and polished surfaces, and compact proportions keep the watch wearable in any context. Yet the Koi edition introduces something less immediate. Something that rewards attention over time rather than impact at first glance. It is not a variation of color. It is a variation of atmosphere. A watch designed to be observed, not announced. The Prometeo spirit, quietly expressed The Prometeo has always drawn inspiration from the great integrated designs of modern watchmaking. From Italian design culture. From the idea that a watch should feel deliberate, not excessive. This special edition does not change that philosophy. It simply narrows the focus. The form remains familiar. The mechanics remain proven. The scene remains.

watches.name: Calipso GMT – Moon Black
watches.description: The Viqueria Calipso GMT – Moon Black blends the robustness of a professional diver with the practicality of a modern travel watch. Powered by the reliable Seiko NH34 automatic movement , it features a true GMT function that allows you to track a second time zone with ease. Built with a 300-meter water-resistant case , domed sapphire crystal and generous layers of SuperLume, the Calipso is designed for real adventure, from ocean depths to everyday exploration. Its balanced 42mm proportions and vintage-inspired design make it equally at home underwater or in daily life. The Moon Black dial adds depth and subtle reflections, giving this instrument watch a refined and distinctive character. Inspired by the sea The name Calipso comes from the legendary sea nymph of Greek mythology, guardian of a mysterious island hidden in the vastness of the ocean. A figure associated with the sea, exploration, and distant horizons. The Viqueria Calipso GMT – Moon Black draws inspiration from that same spirit of discovery. A watch created for those who travel, explore, and move between different worlds, where time is not always measured by a single place. A diver built for adventure The Calipso was designed as a true instrument watch. Its solid stainless steel case and screw-down crown allow it to withstand pressures up to 300 meters of water resistance , making it suitable for real diving environments. The unidirectional bezel allows precise tracking of elapsed time, while the robust construction ensures reliability in demanding conditions. It is a watch built not only to look the part, but to perform when needed. Yet despite its technical nature, the Calipso maintains balanced proportions that make it equally comfortable as an everyday companion. Two time zones, one journey Travel changes the way we experience time. Different cities, different horizons, different moments happening simultaneously around the world. The Calipso GMT is powered by the reliable Seiko NH34 automatic movement , featuring a dedicated GMT hand that allows you to track a second time zone at a glance. Whether crossing continents or simply keeping track of another part of the world, the GMT function transforms the watch into a practical companion for modern explorers. The depth of Moon Black The Moon Black dial gives the Calipso a strong and distinctive identity. Deep, intense, and subtly reflective, it captures light in a way that adds character without compromising readability. Protected by a domed sapphire crystal with anti-reflective treatment, the dial remains crisp and clear from every angle. Combined with powerful luminous material on hands and indexes, the watch remains perfectly legible even in darkness, underwater, or during night travel. Designed for those who explore The Calipso GMT is more than a diver and more than a travel watch. It is the meeting point between two worlds: the depth of the ocean and the distance between time zones. A mechanical companion designed for those who appreciate robust engineering, purposeful design, and the quiet fascination of a watch built to accompany real journeys.

watches.description: FULL SPECIFICATIONS: LIMITED EDITION : 200 individually numbered timepieces. “Hinomaru” Special Edition produced in 50 pieces; WATER RESISTANCE : 10 ATM / 100 meters / 330 feet; CASE : 316L Stainless Steel. 41mm diameter. Lugs Width 20mm. Lug to Lug 46.3mm. Thickness 12,9mm; CASE BACK : Exhibition Caseback with Mineral Glass; DIAL : Applied indices with a sunburst main dial and 3D metal ring on two sub-dials; CRYSTAL : High dome sapphire crystal with Anti-Reflective coating; BEZEL : Fixed position brushed steel bezel insert with tachometer scale; LUME: Japanese C3 LumiNova; BRACELET : 316L marine grade stainless steel “5 link” bracelet; MOVEMENT : Seagull ST19 with Swan Neck regulator; 2 YEARS WARRANTY; DESIGNED AND SHIPPED FROM ITALY. JAPANESE YOUTUBE REVIEW – 日本語でのレビュー ENGLISH YOUTUBE REVIEW Introducing the All-New Viqueria Levante MK3, the third iteration of our beloved Levante model. Limited to just 200 pieces, this edition retains the signature elements of its predecessors while introducing bold new features that make it stand out in the microbrand market. Inspired by the deep connection between motorsports and timekeeping, the Levante MK3 is both complex and reliable, offering precise timekeeping and measurement for racing enthusiasts and watch lovers alike. Powered by the Seagull ST19 movement, known for its column-wheel mechanism, this 41mm timepiece is housed in a 316L stainless steel case with a domed sapphire crystal and AR coating for enhanced clarity. The exhibition caseback reveals the elegance of the upgraded 21-jewel movement, showcasing a historical lineage that dates back to the Venus Calibre 175, a Swiss chronograph movement acquired by Seagull in the 1960s. watches.name: Artista
watches.description: A watch where art becomes part of time. The Viqueria Artista transforms the dial into a miniature canvas, where celestial bodies are painted by hand to capture the beauty of our solar system. Each dial is unique, created through meticulous brushwork and subtle layering of color. Powered by a Swiss Sellita automatic movement, the Artista brings together artistic expression and mechanical precision. A timepiece where horology meets imagination. Time, seen through an artist’s eye. The Viqueria Artista begins with a simple idea: transforming a watch dial into a miniature canvas. Instead of traditional textures or printed patterns, each dial becomes a hand-painted representation of the celestial bodies that surround our planet. Planets, shadows, and subtle variations of color are carefully applied to recreate the quiet beauty of the solar system. Every dial is therefore slightly different — a small universe captured within a mechanical timepiece. Painted by hand Creating an Artista dial requires patience and precision. Each piece is painted by hand using extremely fine brushes and successive layers of pigments. This technique allows the artist to build depth gradually, giving volume to planetary forms and subtle transitions between light and shadow. The process cannot be rushed: each layer must dry before the next is applied, preserving clarity and definition. The result is a dial where no two pieces are ever identical. Each watch carries the individual character of the artist’s hand. A mechanical foundation Behind the artistic dial beats the Swiss Sellita SW200 automatic movement. Known for its reliability and precision, this mechanical caliber represents the traditional foundation of the Artista. While the dial expresses creativity and imagination, the movement provides the quiet mechanical rhythm that defines watchmaking itself. Together, they create a balance between artistic expression and mechanical discipline. Refined presence The stainless-steel case features Viqueria’s signature Black Mirror polishing, a finishing technique designed to produce deep reflections and sharp edges. This refined surface allows the case to frame the dial without competing with it, preserving the focus on the artwork within. Elegant in form yet expressive in character, the Artista transforms the passing of time into a small act of contemplation.

watches.name: Kuro 38mm
watches.description: A dial painted to absorb light itself. The Viqueria Kuro features a hand-finished Musou Black surface, applied in multiple layers to create a depth where light almost disappears. Powered by a Swiss Sellita automatic movement and built with restrained Italian design, the Kuro is a study in contrast. Minimal in appearance. Profound in presence. Black, pushed further. The Viqueria Kuro explores a simple question: how dark can a dial become before it disappears? Not glossy. Not reflective. But truly black. To achieve this, the dial is finished with Musou Black, a Japanese coating capable of absorbing up to 99.4% of visible light. Instead of reflecting illumination back to the eye, the surface traps it, creating a visual depth where shadows dominate and contours soften. Where light fades Musou Black is not a conventional dial finish. It is a pigment engineered to scatter and absorb incoming light rather than reflect it. Applied to a watch dial, the result is unusual: under direct light the surface remains matte and almost textureless. The hands and indexes appear suspended above the dial, as if floating in space. This effect does not rely on color alone. It is the interaction between the microscopic structure of the coating and incoming light that produces the sensation of depth. Painted, not printed Each Kuro dial is finished by hand. The Musou Black coating is applied in multiple layers, slowly building the surface until the desired level of absorption is reached. Unlike traditional lacquered dials, the finish cannot be polished or corrected once applied. Every step requires precision, patience, and careful control of thickness to preserve the coating’s optical properties. The result is a dial that behaves differently depending on the light — calm and minimal in daylight, almost infinite in darker environments. Mechanical clarity Behind the dial beats the Swiss Sellita SW200 automatic movement, a proven caliber known for reliability and serviceability. Regulated and assembled with care, it provides the quiet precision expected from traditional mechanical watchmaking, balancing the experimental nature of the dial with dependable engineering. A study in restraint The Kuro is intentionally minimal. Polished case surfaces and restrained typography leave the dial as the focal point. Rather than drawing attention through complexity, the watch invites a second glance. A different kind of presence. One defined not by brightness, but by depth.

watches.name: Sagittario – Bursting Blue
watches.description: Inspired by the elegance and speed of early jet aviation, the Viqueria Sagittario – Sparkling Black pays tribute to the legendary Ambrosini Sagittario, the first Italian military jet developed after World War II. This limited edition of just 50 pieces combines aviation inspiration with mechanical watchmaking. Powered by the reliable Swiss Sellita SW200 automatic movement , the Sagittario features an unusual and fascinating complication: an inclinometer integrated into the caseback , capable of measuring the angle of inclination using the rotor and gravity. A distinctive timepiece that blends technical curiosity, Italian design, and Swiss precision , assembled in Italy and designed for enthusiasts who appreciate watches with character. Born from the sky In the years following World War II, Italy looked to the sky once again. In 1953, a small experimental jet entered the history of Italian aviation: the Ambrosini Sagittario .
